narration: Your team's daily lunches out came up in month {fork_month}, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. After a low point in month {ghost_lowest_month}, the ghost's money stayed above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's cushion for a stretch with no pay ended thicker, its Safety {safety_gap}. Both lives closed with Life at {real_life}, nearer getting by than living.
